questions.stem: Which feature must a bar chart for categorical data have?

options.text: A line connecting the tops of bars

questions.explanation: For categorical (discrete) data, bar charts should have gaps between the bars to show that the categories are separate. Bars touch only when the data is continuous (as in a histogram).

questions.stem: A dual bar chart shows data for boys and girls across four subjects. What is the main advantage of a dual bar chart over two separate bar charts?

options.text: It makes it easy to compare the two groups side by side
It shows the total more clearly

questions.explanation: A dual (or comparative) bar chart places bars for different groups next to each other for each category, making direct comparison between groups easy.
